acip: DNGOS PO DANG 'GAL BA'I MTSAN NYID YOD DE, KHYOD DNGOS PO DANG THA DAD, KHYOD YANG YIN, DNGOS PO YANG YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA MI SRID PA DE YIN PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: dngos po dang 'gal ba'i mtshan nyid yod de, khyod dngos po dang tha dad, khyod yang yin, dngos po yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa mi srid pa de yin pa'i phyir
english: There does exist a definition for something which is contradictory to a working thing, because “That which is different from a working thing, and such that it would be impossible to find an example of something which was both it and also a working thing” is just that definition.
